name: @shepherdjerred/the-storm
description: Turbo shim over the Gradle build of The Storm's Paper plugin (plugin/) — scripts wrap Gradle so the workspace joins the task graph (caching + affected). Same pattern as the Go and Rust shims.

scripts.lint: mise exec -- gradle -p plugin spotlessCheck pmdMain pmdTest --console=plain
scripts.typecheck: mise exec -- gradle -p plugin compileJava compileTestJava --console=plain
